examples.question_text: A bee flies $96\text{ m}$ in $15\text{ s}$ at constant speed. Find its speed.

examples.solution_text:
The endpoints are $(0,0)$ and $(2,120)$. The line's gradient gives the average speed.

$\begin{aligned}\text{Average speed}&=\dfrac{\Delta d}{\Delta t}\\&=\dfrac{120-0}{2-0}\\&=60\text{ km/h}\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: A runner travels $11\text{ km}$ in $48\text{ minutes}$ at constant speed. Find the speed in $\text{km/h}$.
examples.solution_text:
Convert the time to hours.

$\begin{aligned}\text{Time}&=\dfrac{48}{60}\\&=0.8\text{ h}\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}\text{Speed}&=\dfrac{11}{0.8}\\&=13.75\text{ km/h}\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: A drone travels $325\text{ m}$ in $24\text{ s}$ at constant speed. Find its speed in $\text{m/s}$, rounded to $2$ decimal places.
A boat travels $2.85\text{ km}$ in $2\text{ min }30\text{ s}$ at constant speed. Find its speed in $\text{m/s}$.
examples.solution_text:
Convert the distance to metres and the whole elapsed time to seconds.

$\begin{aligned}\text{Distance}&=2.85\times1000\\&=2850\text{ m}\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}\text{Time}&=2\times60+30\\&=150\text{ s}\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}\text{Speed}&=\dfrac{2850}{150}\\&=19\text{ m/s}\end{aligned}$

examples.derivation: The graph records 24 km at both 2 h and 3 h, then 48 km at 5 h. Including the stopped hour, average speed = (48−0)/(5−0) = 9.6 km/h. The solution secant joins the correct endpoints.
The graph scales place the endpoint at (2 h, 120 km). Average speed = (120−0)/(2−0) = 60 km/h.
325/24 = 13.541666… m/s, which rounds to 13.54 m/s to two decimal places.
